reason: I already pay Smoobu and my son handles the Booking messages, so the guests already get their answers. I don't trust a new one-person company and a robot to speak to my guests in August, when a wrong answer means a bad review.
objection: If this small company closes or the man gets sick in the middle of the season, who answers my guests? Smoobu and my agency will still be here next year. This one I don't know.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour host I know on the coast who used it a full season and tells me face to face that the guests liked it and it never said anything wrong, and it works inside Smoobu so I don't add another thing.
